name: Pixel Arcade
tagline: A pixel runner in a sun-bleached desert, a near miss, a CLOSE CALL! tag and an arcade end card.
description: Square 8-bit gameplay style for indie games, playful launches and challenges. Box-shadow pixel sprites on a warm desert with stepped parallax ridges, a two-frame run cycle, motion snapped to an 8px grid, a red CLOSE CALL! tag on the near miss, a ticking score HUD, and a white flash into a chunky pixel end card with a blinking PRESS START.

display.usage: Title 76px with a hard 6px drop shadow; HUD and tags 26–30px

transitions: white flash (0.06s) into the end card
end card drops in on 6 discrete steps
textAnimations: score counts up every frame and jumps +500 on the near miss
CLOSE CALL! tag pops on steps(3), floats up on steps(5)
PRESS START blinks with steps(1) yoyo

rhythm.notes: One continuous gameplay shot (~5s) with two obstacles, then the end card. The run cycle flips every 0.14s.

guide:
- Draw sprites with a single element and a box-shadow per pixel (9–14px pixels); no images.
- Snap every moving x/y to an 8px grid with a GSAP modifiers function so motion feels like hardware.
- Use stepped column ridges at two depths for parallax (far moves ~40% of the ground speed).
- Two-frame run cycle toggled with visibility every 0.14s; jumps are power2 up/down, snapped.
- Only stepped eases for UI (steps(1–6)); never smooth fades except the white flash.
- HUD in Press Start 2P: SCORE left, HI right. End on a paper card with a hard 16px shadow, red title, real details (where to play, platforms) and a blinking PRESS START.
